content.text:
Fixed. `npm test` now passes.

**Cause:** `parseDate` in `src/dates.js` passed the ISO month straight to `Date.UTC`, which expects months 0–11. Every parsed date landed one month late, so an invoice issued Jan 30 was treated as Feb 30 (Mar 2), and its net-14 due date came out as Mar 16.

**Fix:** it now calls `Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d)`.

`src/report.js` also calls `parseDate`, so its output changes too. It was off by a month before and should now be correct.

Invoices already issued with the wrong due dates may have been stored or sent to customers. I only fixed the calculation, so any saved due dates would need a separate check.
